summary: Prudential PLC filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Q1 2026 business performance update, a routine earnings release. The filing reports new business profit of $686 million, up 10% year-over-year, and APE sales of $1,823 million, up 6%. No special-situation corporate event (acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, restructuring, etc.) is announced. The update is a standard periodic financial disclosure for a foreign private issuer, not a special situation.
